values.note: $45 a night for every campsite, county residents and non-residents alike (2027 on the booking site, June weekday and Saturday); a $5 processing fee per site reserved. The vehicle entrance permit for one vehicle is included with a camping reservation (extra vehicles $6/day; two vehicles per site). 30 consecutive nights $840 resident / $985 non-county and a full season $2,600 / $3,200, on a limited lottery allotment.

values.note: Reserve online or call the park (989-644-2388, seasonal) or the Parks Main Office (989-317-4083). Sites 1-22 have a 14-day limit; the other sites have none. Discounted 30-night and full-season stays go by a lottery list closing December 1.

note: Isabella County park on the shores of Coldwater Lake, an all-sports lake, near Weidman west of Mount Pleasant: sandy swimming beach, five rustic cabins, playground and three pavilions. The 50-amp sites are 65-67, 76-82 and 95-103. --Claude
